name: IBJJF Strategy Guide
description: IBJJF membership, division, uniform and rules requirements that shape tournament participation.
summary: Registration, uniforms and permitted techniques depend on the athlete’s event and division.
overview:
An IBJJF entry depends on more than a preferred weight class. Membership must reflect the athlete’s current belt and academy, and the event defines its available age and belt divisions. Published weight limits include the competition uniform.

Age, belt and gi/no-gi format also matter to technique restrictions. Uniform inspection and the rules on lack of combativeness remain relevant regardless of a competitor’s intended style. The event page supplies its correction deadlines, weight chart and schedule; those details are not universal across tournaments.

flashcards.question: Do the division weight limits described by IBJJF’s My First Championship page include the competition uniform?
flashcards.answer: Yes. The page states that the event weight chart gives the maximum allowed weight with the uniform on.

flashcards.question: Does IBJJF treat every held top position identically when assessing lack of combativeness?
flashcards.answer: No. Article 6.2.1 distinguishes situations, including an exception for mount or back position while the technical position’s characteristics are maintained.
